notes: Phase 4.2F remains the generic manual persistence gate for production artifacts that are not covered by a later narrow automatic gate.
Phase 4.4E daily FX/gold and Phase 4.5A verified NSO monthly statistics use separate append-only auto-persistence policies; this manual policy is unchanged for all other indicators.
Only a successful macro-production artifact from the main branch may be persisted.
The frontend remains disconnected from direct workflow writes; it reads committed repository data.
Git history is the repository-level rollback mechanism; workflow-only _snapshots are not committed.
